name: ConformalKeypoint
summary: Reference code for conformal keypoint prediction sets and pose uncertainty sets (CVPR 2023).
why_it_matters: Shows the calibration loop for turning a learned geometric measurement into a coverage-calibrated region.
hackathon_notes: No license file (gh api 2026-11-09): read the calibration scripts, re-implement. Last push 2023-06.

name: SafeVPR
summary: Accept/abstain verifier for place-recognition matches: DINOv2 patch-agreement score plus Mondrian conformal threshold calibration with an FDR target.
why_it_matters: The closest open code to calibrated acceptance of visual fixes; MIT, so it can be adapted for aerial fixes.
hackathon_notes: MIT. README: `pip install -e .` then `python demo.py` runs on bundled real scores without a GPU. Swap its score for our inliers + retrieval margin on cached VPAIR candidates. Ground datasets only in the paper.

name: OrthoLoC
summary: Dataset tools and code for UAV 6-DoF localization and calibration against orthophotos and surface models (NeurIPS 2025 D&B).
why_it_matters: Paired UAV images, orthophotos and DSMs let a team evaluate the matching stage without retrieval.
hackathon_notes: LICENSE file is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (read via gh api): evaluation only, no commercial use. Data is large (about 287 GB per project page, not checked); use a subset.

name: MegaLoc
summary: General image-retrieval model for localization tasks, trained across many VPR datasets.
why_it_matters: A permissive retrieval front end to compare against AnyLoc and DINOv2 GeM for the coarse stage of aerial visual fixes.
hackathon_notes: MIT code; weight terms not checked separately. Drop-in for the retrieval stage of vpr-large-area.

name: MSCEqF
summary: Multi-state-constraint equivariant filter for vision-aided inertial navigation (RA-L 2023).
why_it_matters: Permissive (Apache-2.0) reference implementation of an equivariant INS filter.
hackathon_notes: Apache-2.0. Read for structure; for a 48h POC write the filter in Python and use this to check equations.

name: Lie++
summary: Header-only C++ / Eigen library for Lie group operations used by the AAU equivariant filters.
why_it_matters: Apache-2.0 alternative to manif for onboard equivariant or invariant filters.
hackathon_notes: Apache-2.0. Useful when porting a Python POC filter to C++ for the product story.

name: Equivariant symmetries for INS (code)
summary: MATLAB code accompanying the paper comparing IEKF and equivariant filters for GNSS-aided inertial navigation.
why_it_matters: Ready-made comparison of symmetry choices for an INS filter, the starting point for a consistency study.
hackathon_notes: No license file (gh api 2026-11-09): read only, re-implement in Python. Repository name is spelled 'equivaraint' upstream.

name: InGVIO
summary: Invariant filter fusing monocular or stereo visual-inertial data with raw GNSS.
why_it_matters: Open invariant-filter GNSS-VIO with fixed-wing data; a consistency reference.
hackathon_notes: No license file (gh api 2026-11-09): read only. ROS-based C++ build; too heavy for 48h beyond reading.

name: Loc-NeRF
summary: Monte Carlo localization of a camera against a neural radiance field map.
why_it_matters: Reference for putting a neural field map inside a particle filter.
hackathon_notes: MIT. Last push 2022-10. Read for the PF-against-neural-map loop; GPU and NeRF training needed to run.

name: ImplicitTerrainV2
summary: Code for wavelet-guided adaptive neural terrain fields with derivative-aware training and quantization.
why_it_matters: MIT neural DEM representation with good gradients, the piece a compressed-map TRN POC needs.
hackathon_notes: MIT. Fit fields per GLO-30 window and swap them into terrain-heightmap-pf. Training time on CPU/MPS not measured.

name: SWA-PF
summary: Semantic-weighted adaptive particle filter for 4-DoF UAV localization against satellite maps, with the MAFS dataset.
why_it_matters: Semantic particle weighting is one route to robustness against map age.
hackathon_notes: No license file (gh api 2026-11-09): read only. MAFS dataset terms not checked.
